title: outbox receipt missing read_at_unix retries forever instead of failing permanently
description: In outbox_tick, when a receipt outbox entry has read_at_unix=None (missing required field), the code calls record_failure (backoff retry) not mark_failed. This is a permanent data corruption: the missing timestamp will never appear. The entry will be retried forever wasting CPU and log noise. Should call mark_failed to terminate the retry loop.
